title: Single-Leg Leg Press
summary: A leg press one leg at a time, to train each side on its own without balance demands.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for quads (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly quads total.
Library rating 0.6 for glutes (helper): each working set adds 0.6 of a set to the weekly glutes total.
Library rating 0.4 for adductors (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly adductors total.

setup.text: Sit in the leg press with one foot in the middle of the platform.
Lower until your knee is deeply bent, keeping your hips on the seat.
Press back up, then switch legs.

form_cues.cue: Lower until the knee is deeply bent
Keep the hip on the seat
Stop before your lower back lifts off the pad.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Both sides together, Heavier loading potential.
Swap sheet: Less stable, Both sides together, More technical.
Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Both sides together, Heavier loading potential.
